questions.question: How does Archlens decide that a handbook page is stale, and does a source change that was already committed still count?
key: sync records content IDs (Git blob hashes) of covered and linked files, plus fingerprints of cited line ranges, in .archlens-state.json
covered files come from map.json covers glob patterns plus files the page links to
status compares the recorded fingerprints with current content
yes, committed changes still count because it compares content, not a base ref
stale when cited evidence changed or moved; review when only other covered files changed; neither proves the prose is wrong

questions.question: Why do most native Claude Code Archlens commands run in an isolated (forked) task, and which command does not?
key: keep exploration and large source traces out of the parent conversation context
return only a bounded result to the parent
worker does not receive prior conversation, so evidence must be supplied
learn runs inline so the user can ask follow-up questions

questions.question: Why does Archlens keep page metadata in a JSON map.json instead of YAML frontmatter?
key: the checker uses only the Python standard library / no package install
a YAML parser would be an extra dependency, and a custom YAML subset parser is ambiguous and risky
one map.json with explicit schema, duplicate-key and schema checks
cost: authors must maintain the separate map and coverage patterns

questions.question: What is the size limit of the checker's --summary output, and how does it avoid silently dropping records?
key: 6000 UTF-8 bytes
keeps whole records rather than truncating JSON
reports totals and omitted counts
hints to use --json saved to a local file for full details

questions.question: In what order does Archlens merge its configuration files, and which one wins?
key: bundled defaults.json first
then one user file: ARCHLENS_CONFIG, else CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/archlens.json, else XDG or ~/.config/archlens/config.json if present, else legacy ~/.claude/archlens.json
then project .archlens.json
later layers replace earlier keys; only one user file is read

questions.question: How is the portable Agent Skill kept consistent with the native Claude plugin?
key: the plugin is canonical; tools/sync_portable.py generates skills/archlens from it
it rewrites Claude placeholders such as ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} and $ARGUMENTS
--check reports stale, missing, unexpected or linked resources
run in CI / pre-commit / tests

questions.question: What do the Archlens Claude Code hooks do in a project that has no Archlens handbook, or when the hook input is malformed?
key: they print nothing / stay silent
exit code 0 so they never break the session
only projects with a map.json (opted in) get the session map or stop reminder

questions.question: If I use Codex or Cursor instead of Claude Code, how can those agents learn about and keep up with the Archlens handbook?
key: set contextFile (for example AGENTS.md) in .archlens.json
context --write / sync writes a managed archlens:context block with the compact page map (without live stale flags)
plugin hooks do not run in other hosts
pre-commit hooks (archlens-stale, archlens-check) or CI status --fail-on-stale detect stale pages
